columns.comment: Onboarding case id (ONB-nnnnn); join to fact_onboarding_case.
columns.name: case_id

columns.comment: Stage number 1-7 in funnel order; join to gold.dim_onboarding_stage.
columns.name: stage_no

columns.comment: Stage: Request, KYC Docs, Screening, Risk Assessment, Credit/Product Approval, Account Open, First Transaction.
columns.name: stage_name

columns.comment: dim_client version of the onboarded client valid on the stage entry date (null for applicants that never went live).
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Golden client of the onboarded entity (null for applicants that never went live).
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group of the case (ER group of the client, else the intake group link).
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Date the case entered the stage.
columns.name: entered_date

columns.comment: Date the case left the stage; null while still in it (or abandoned there).
columns.name: exited_date

columns.comment: Calendar days in the stage (to the as-of date when not exited); First Transaction = days from go-live to the first transaction.
columns.name: days_in_stage

columns.comment: SLA for the stage in calendar days.
columns.name: sla_days

columns.comment: True when days_in_stage <= sla_days.
columns.name: is_sla_met

columns.comment: True when the stage ran (or is running) over its SLA.
columns.name: is_over_sla

columns.comment: Days beyond the stage SLA (0 when within SLA).
columns.name: days_over_sla

columns.comment: True for the stage a case is currently in (not exited).
columns.name: is_current_stage

columns.comment: True when the stage was exited.
columns.name: is_stage_completed

columns.comment: Onboarding officer handling the stage (employee_id).
columns.name: actor_id

columns.comment: True on exactly one row per case (stage 1): use for case counts and median / P90 days to live.
columns.name: is_case_primary_row

columns.comment: Request date of the case.
columns.name: request_date

columns.comment: First day of the request month (Request Month).
columns.name: request_month

columns.comment: Booking location of the case (ISO-2); join to gold.dim_booking_entity.
columns.name: booking_country

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: segment

columns.comment: Anchor product requested (Current Account / Correspondent Account).
columns.name: primary_product

columns.comment: Case status at the as-of date: Open, Live, Withdrawn or Rejected.
columns.name: case_status

columns.comment: Days from request to go-live of the case (live cases; repeated on each stage row - aggregate on is_case_primary_row).
columns.name: case_days_to_live

columns.comment: Request period vs the Feb-2026 KYC workflow migration: Pre-migration, Migration (Feb-2026), Backlog peak (Mar-May 2026), Recovery (from Jun-2026).
columns.name: kyc_migration_period

columns.comment: True for cases requested on or after 1-Feb-2026.
columns.name: is_after_kyc_migration

comment: Onboarding funnel stage events (brief 5.6): one row per onboarding case x stage entered (1 Request, 2 KYC Docs, 3 Screening, 4 Risk Assessment, 5 Credit/Product Approval, 6 Account Open, 7 First Transaction) with entered / exited dates, days in stage (to 30-Sep-2026 for the stage a case is in), the stage SLA and SLA met / over-SLA flags, the actor, and the case attributes used to slice cycle time (request date / month, booking country, segment, status, days to live, KYC-migration period). is_case_primary_row (the stage-1 row) is true once per case: compute case-level measures (cases, median / P90 days to live) on it; stage measures (average days in stage, SLA met %) use every row of the stage. Grain: one row per onboarding case x stage.
